history.summary: A compact (764 sqft) 3-bedder at Tre Residences — a 99-yr (2014) D14 condo with an outstanding 440m covered-walkway link to Aljunied MRT (EWL) plus Mattar MRT (DTL) nearby. The location, liquid $1.48M price band and below-district-median PSF are genuine positives, but you're paying slightly ABOVE the building's own recent comparable transactions for its least-desirable layout (a micro 3BR), with only modest ~3.6% yield and below-RCR-baseline appreciation. A fair-to-slightly-rich price for a well-located but compromised unit.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $1,937 sits BELOW the D14 median (~$2,200, ratio 0.88) which looks like value — but it is ~1% ABOVE Tre Residences' own current average ($1,918) and above a directly comparable 764 sqft unit that transacted at $1,871 PSF in Oct 2025. So at list you are paying up, not getting a deal, for the project's tightest 3BR layout (764 sqft / 3 beds = 255 sqft/bed; algo flags bedroom_sqft_mismatch). Offsetting that: best-in-class transit access (covered 5-min walk to Aljunied EWL + Mattar DTL), liquid price point for HDB upgraders, healthy ~87yr lease, and a reliable 4.19%/yr URA appreciation history from 108 honest resale transactions (no new-launch bias). Net: solid fundamentals, but neither the price nor the layout nor the ~3.6% yield justifies a Buy at list. Negotiate toward ~$1.42-1.43M (≈$1,870 PSF, in line with recent comps) and confirm a good floor/facing to turn this into a Buy.

Kallang Riverside / Greater Kallang waterfront and sports-hub rejuvenation nearby

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Tenant demand is good — city-fringe, two MRT lines, covered walkway, near Paya Lebar/Kallang employment. The pipeline's $3,209/mo (district-3BR average) understates a transit-adjacent unit; a realistic rent for this 764 sqft compact 3BR is ~$4,300-4,600/mo, which is still only ~3.5-3.7% gross at $1.48M. The compact layout rents like a large 2BR, so yield is the weak link for an investment-led purchase.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: URA data is reliable here: 4.19%/yr annualized over 5 years from 108 resale transactions (data_confidence 1.0, no new-launch bias). That is honest but below the RCR ~5.8% baseline. PSF at $1,937 is ~0.88x the D14 median, leaving headroom vs district, but the project has already re-rated (5yr +22.8%) and a compact 3BR is unlikely to lead the development's appreciation. Expect ~4-4.5%/yr capital growth, supported by PLC/Kallang catalysts.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: Floor and facing are not stated in the listing — this is the biggest gap in the call. At Tre Residences, prefer mid-to-high floors and pool/internal-facing or east-facing stacks; avoid west-facing units (equatorial afternoon heat) and stacks fronting the PIE / MRT viaduct (noise). Before committing, confirm: (1) floor level (>=8th preferred), (2) facing/orientation, (3) whether any bedroom is windowless/internal given the tight 764 sqft. The rating assumes an average mid-floor stack; a low-floor west/PIE-facing unit would push this toward Avoid, while a high-floor quiet-facing unit at a negotiated price would support a Buy.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA 5yr CAGR for Tre Residences (108 resale transactions, ura_district_5yr_cagr cache, confidence 1.0)
